description: Runtime clients and execution helpers shared by Clash product surfaces.

modules.src/workspace-init.ts: Preserves the canonical directory marker and optionally registers its identity through the caller's Host request. Public CLI/MCP supply that request; offline fixtures may prepare markers only. Registration failures retain identity for idempotent retry; conflicting markers are never rebound.
modules.src/project-content-client.ts: Shared list/search/read transport for Project content: GET/POST the scoped content route, then read existing Media or exact Document revision authorities using returned refs. Validates bounded query/result contracts without introducing another reference format.
modules.src/action-client.ts: Operation-oriented discovery, invocation and bounded wait shared by CLI/MCP; reuse native Generator/Run/output contracts, project scope and frozen input refs. A timeout retains the same Run identity rather than resubmitting.
modules.src/asset-evidence-client.ts: One-call external evidence recording through existing Document create/read/attach APIs; stable record ids repair attachment retries, while changed content is rejected. Detail is never executed.
modules.src/asset-search-client.ts: Browser-safe Project content search adapter plus the shared Asset-evidence projection used by the compatibility Host route; retains exact Document revisions and times only for the actual source Asset.
modules.src/browser.ts: Browser/Worker exports; never import filesystem, daemon discovery, or process helpers here.
modules.src/project-host-http.ts: Single HTTP transport for existing project Host commands. Browser callers inject their runtime request; Node callers supply the discovered endpoint.
modules.src/project-host-client.ts: Node workspace-marker and Host endpoint resolution, reusing project-host-http transport.
modules.src/timeline-client.ts: Native Timeline Host projection client. Keep the returned observation with each draft; never rotate an old draft's CAS evidence after a background refresh.
modules.src/generator-client.ts: Generic Generator/Revision/Action Run/Output Commit HTTP client.
modules.src/document-client.ts: Platform-neutral native Document HTTP client for kinds/heads/history/exact bodies, create/advance/copy and attachments. Internal observations travel in request headers; public envelope sanitation preserves user body fields. CLI and MCP reuse this transport, without Node storage or manifest authority.
modules.src/logging.ts: Browser-safe versioned diagnostics, structured Error context, bounded sanitization and duplicate summaries. No filesystem or Node imports.
modules.src/observability.ts: Node JSONL sinks and stdio capture; bounded rotation, process run identity, console severity, line framing and startup-only forwarding.
modules.src/log-reader.ts: Read-only local diagnostic query across desktop and Host rotations; legacy compatibility, event summaries and original file/line locations.
modules.src/project-status.ts: Shared Project storage/recovery diagnostics and cloud gates. Readiness requires an exact Project/local-replica admission marked ready by the Host synchronizer; global transport capability flags cannot grant readiness. Raw modes remain conservative recovery hints.
modules.src/project-cloud-sync.ts: Platform-neutral phased Project synchronization with monotonic admission-version CAS. New writes/revocation cancel stale completion; a ready record is rechecked on reconciliation. Exposed via the narrow project-cloud-sync subpath.
modules.src/minimax-executor.ts: Portable MiniMax submit/poll execution, shared by executable plugin and hosted adapter through a narrow subpath. No Node Buffer or credentials persistence. Provider failures come from action-sdk/executable-failure; the SDK Node root is not a portable dependency.
modules.src/gemini-omni.ts: Google Interactions and Files one-request primitives; pending file processing returns control to the durable owner.
modules.src/provider-browser-boundary.test.ts: Bundles portable Provider sources and the Action SDK executable-failure subpath for browser, executes HTTP failure classification without Node globals, and verifies narrow/root class identity and published subpath resolution.
modules.src/project-authorization.ts: Backend-neutral Project transport authentication and connection revalidation. D1/PostgreSQL supply authority records; signature verification and session resolution are injected trusted adapters. Narrow export only; no Node or Cloudflare dependencies.
modules.src/project-authorization-postgres.ts: PostgreSQL authority-record adapter via injected query port. PostgreSQL timestamptz becomes policy milliseconds. The host owns pooling/migrations; this is not a complete Node cloud server.
modules.src/project-cloud-admission.ts: Portable admission validation and atomic persistence port, shared by D1 and PostgreSQL.
modules.src/project-cloud-admission-postgres.ts: PostgreSQL admission persistence with a host-owned pinned transaction; owner/tenant arbitration and rollback.
modules.src/cloud-run-coordinator.ts: Shared cloud owner coordinator over DurableRunEngine, used by CF and Node; frozen journal-first creation and owner checks.
modules.src/cloud-run-journal.ts: Platform-neutral cloud journal record validation, serialization, frozen-field comparison and recovery scheduling; D1 and PG supply persistence.
modules.src/hosted-generation.ts: Portable hosted generation admission, frozen route/input validation, journal-before-schedule, retry policy, access/claim checks and lifecycle hooks. No CF/Node runtime imports.
modules.src/generation-params.ts: Existing hosted generation wire contract shared across adapters; historical R2-named fields remain wire compatibility, not a requirement to emulate R2.
modules.src/generator-contract.ts: Node-side Generator schema validation shared by Host adapters; no filesystem or database authority.
modules.src/timeline-generator-product.ts: Shared Timeline Generator operations over Project Loro and the installed definition. Canvas-owned create/advance/attach/copy ensure consumed media placements through Canvas; reference edges derive from native revision inputs rather than legacy Timeline bindings. Local Host compatibility exports preserve existing callers.
modules.src/executable-plugin-schema-hash.ts: Canonical plugin schema identity shared by Local Host and Node contract loading; preserves existing package hashing including all contributions.
modules.src/local-daemon.ts: Single-writer detached Host bootstrap and upgrade detection. Runtime fingerprints include adjacent immutable bundled-plugin payloads and the staged runtime-dependencies.sha256 identity because imported modules remain cached until the Host restarts.
